narration.text: A distributor's background-check rejections taken in the order the FCRA sets: four pre-adverse notices with the report and the summary of rights, final notices for three whose own wait has ended and a namesake's dispute sent on, while a skills test, a hire, a missing authorization and a corrected report are left alone. This is a chore for the HR coordinator of a 118-person Texas wholesale distributor that makes its offers contingent on a background report. Athena works it across 3 portals: Applyrook ATS, Veritarn Screening and Postwren. On the bench, she found 8 of 8 eligible items, worth 8,000 dollars of the 8,000 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 24 traps, and she walked past 24. She took 1 minute. By hand, the same chore takes 45 minutes, so she was about 32 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
